name: cordclean
description: CordClean - 基于 Cordis 插件框架的模块化电脑清理工具

scripts.test:ai: vitest run tests/ai.test.ts tests/ai-shapes.test.ts tests/ai-robust.test.ts tests/ai-context.test.ts tests/ai-selection.test.ts
scripts.test:engine: vitest run tests/engine.test.ts tests/engine-robust.test.ts tests/rules.test.ts tests/plugin-rules.test.ts tests/quarantine.test.ts tests/sessions.test.ts tests/scheduler.test.ts tests/undo.test.ts tests/in-use.test.ts tests/state.test.ts tests/shortcuts.test.ts
